name: Yoga school in Prague
reason: Re-searched under the 12 Nov rule (three searches, 12 Nov 2026): the lineage candidates that came up (Iyengar Yoga Institut Praha, Traditional Ashtanga Praha, International Yoga Academy with 200h/550h trainings) appeared only on directories and guides (svoboda-williams, firmy.cz, ashtangayoga.info, findedeinyoga.org, tripaligner, bookretreats), with no own website found to confirm a current teacher training, and directories are never a source. Prague Yoga Collective (the earlier candidate) was not re-opened; its results this run showed only 2025 training dates. City skipped again; the owner may want Prague Yoga Collective judged on scope directly.
